name: Knott's Boardwalk BBQ Smoked Beef Brisket Platter with White Bread
whyItWorks: Tender, hickory-smoked beef brisket sliced thick and served with soft white bread and mild barbecue sauce. Pure unbreaded beef with broken-down muscle collagen.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Beef Brisket platter with white bread and mashed potatoes or mac & cheese; ask for sweet mild BBQ sauce on the side.
watchOuts: Trim visible edge fat if fat-sensitive
